description: M3-C unit C1a4-blind companion blind-mode controls (C1a plan r6 RF-3), hermetic, on synthetic stores, receipts and models only: a canary in held-out names and content never reaches the receipt, stdout or stderr; each error class, and an over-item-5 entry's closed row; a held-out member as MODEL; the blind margins equal to the lead-readable measure; the generic command-line failure line, and abbreviated options refused; invalid receipts refuse; a blind result survives regeneration, returns the caps when failing, is incomplete or outstanding as its state says, and goes stale on drift in each binding; the ordinary mode touches no held-out store, and the join refuses outside the mode; every product path the tool and the model name is bound.
